description: The only funding scanner that nets every gap against the real cost of opening and closing both legs on live order books — 23 perp DEXs, every minute, with how long each gap usually lasts. PAID: 0.1 USDC on Base per scan, via x402 (no account; an x402-enabled client pays automatically). Every pair and every venue couple across perp DEXs, read every minute: long where funding is lowest, short where it is highest, net of opening and closing both legs at market on the live books, with how long each gap has been open and how long its past gaps lasted. Not charged if the data is not fresh.
